NOTICE OF ADVERSE DETERMINATION - MEDICAL NECESSITY

Cascade Mutual has completed a medical necessity review of the inpatient admission identified above. Based on the submitted medical record, this request is denied as an adverse determination for medical necessity. The admission does not meet the applicable inpatient criteria under the MCG-style guideline set applied by this plan.

Basis for determination:
The medical record does not document clinical severity sufficient to require inpatient admission.

Guideline codes reviewed and findings:

SEP-02 - Not met. Finding: Antibiotic therapy could have been given in an outpatient or observation setting.

SEP-03 - Not met. Finding: There was no evidence of new organ dysfunction.

No other guideline codes were applied in reaching this adverse determination for medical necessity.

Claim adjustment codes applied to this claim:
CARC CO-50
RARC N115

This determination addresses medical necessity only. The review was conducted by a physician reviewer, and the findings above reflect the documentation available in the record submitted for the admission spanning [[ADMIT_DATE]] to [[DISCHARGE_DATE]].

Appeal rights and instructions:
The member, the member's authorized representative, or the treating provider may request an appeal of this adverse determination. Appeals must be submitted in writing and addressed to Utilization Management at the address shown on this notice. Each written appeal argument should reference the applicable guideline code (SEP-02 or SEP-03) and respond to the specific finding stated above for that code. The appeal submission must include a physician attestation line signed by the treating physician. Supporting records relevant to the cited findings should be attached.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that deadline may be closed without review of the merits.

A copy of the specific guideline provisions used in this review is available upon written request at no charge.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
